args.title: Fix duplicate detection for overlapping statement uploads in dedupe.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The deduplication process in `dedupe.ts` doesn't properly handle scenarios where overlapping statement uploads occur, causing duplicates to be missed when statements are uploaded back-to-back. This issue was observed when uploading September and October statements, where both contain overlapping days at the end of September. The solution involves modifying the deduplication logic to correctly identify and handle these overlapping periods. This change ensures that duplicates are caught even when multiple statements with overlapping dates are imported in quick succession, as expected.
